14.label: L Time
14.description: Controls the primary time-based parameter for the left channel effect. Function varies by effect: Size (Reverb), Swell Time/Delay (Pitch), Rate (Warp).

15.label: Mix
15.description: Balance between your dry input signal and the Lost+Found effect. Lock this to preserve your wet/dry balance when loading presets.

16.label: R Time
16.description: Controls the primary time-based parameter for the right channel effect. Function varies by effect: Delay Time/Grain Size (Delay), Portamento/Onset (Synth), Rate (Bend).

17.label: L Modify
17.description: Morphs between two variations of the left effect (A and B). Turn left for variant A, right for variant B. The arc labels show which effects you're blending between.

18.label: Blend
18.description: Balance between the left and right effect channels. Turn left to favor left channel, right to favor right channel. Center is equal blend.

19.label: R Modify
19.description: Morphs between two variations of the right effect (A and B). Turn left for variant A, right for variant B. The arc labels show which effects you're blending between.

24.label: L Alt
24.description: Secondary parameter for the left channel effect. Function varies by effect: Diffusion (Reverb), Feedback/Repeats (Pitch), Resonance (Warp).

25.label: Spill
25.description: When in series routing, apply the second effect in the series to your dry signal as well.

26.label: R Alt
26.description: Secondary parameter for the right channel effect. Function varies by effect: Stability/Grain Shape (Delay), Attack-Release/Octave (Synth), Voices/Crinkles (Bend).

27.label: L EQ
27.description: Tone control for the left channel. Turn left to cut highs for darker tones, right to boost highs for brighter tones. Center is neutral.

28.label: Glue
28.description: Adds subtle compression and saturation to glue the effects together. Creates cohesion between the two channels.

29.label: R EQ
29.description: Tone control for the right channel. Turn left to cut highs for darker tones, right to boost highs for brighter tones. Center is neutral.

30.label: Master Wet
30.description: Master output level for the wet signal. Use to match the overall effect level to your dry signal.

leftFx.title: Left FX
leftFx.description: Select the effect family for the left channel. Toggle Swap to access the alternate effect set.

options.Reverb: Lush reverb effects: Slow-verb (A) or Useful Ambience (B)
options.Pitch: Pitch-based effects: Orchestral Swell (A) or Pitch Repeater (B)
options.Warp: Modulation effects: Pinging Phaser (A) or Spectral Modulator (B)
options.Delay: Delay effects: Tape Echo (A) or Grain Tumbler (B)
options.Synth: Synth-like effects: Impulse Synthesizer (A) or Sympathetic Resonator (B)
options.Bend: Chorus/Warp effects: Ensemble Expander (A) or Gen Lite (B)

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: Signal routing between left and right channels

options.L>R: Series: Left channel feeds into right channel
options.L+R: Parallel: Left and right channels run independently
options.L<R: Series: Right channel feeds into left channel

rightFx.title: Right FX
rightFx.description: Select the effect family for the right channel. Toggle Swap to access the alternate effect set.

options.Delay: Delay effects: Tape Echo (A) or Grain Tumbler (B)
options.Synth: Synth-like effects: Impulse Synthesizer (A) or Sympathetic Resonator (B)
options.Bend: Chorus/Warp effects: Ensemble Expander (A) or Gen Lite (B)
options.Reverb: Lush reverb effects: Slow-verb (A) or Useful Ambience (B)
options.Pitch: Pitch-based effects: Orchestral Swell (A) or Pitch Repeater (B)
options.Warp: Modulation effects: Pinging Phaser (A) or Spectral Modulator (B)

bounce.label: Bounce
bounce.description: When enabled, the ramp oscillates back and forth instead of resetting to the start position.

sweep.label: Sweep
sweep.description: When enabled, the expression sweep range is inverted (heel becomes toe and vice versa).

speed.label: Ramp Speed
speed.description: Controls how fast the ramp cycles through its range. Faster speeds create more obvious modulation effects.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Master enable for the ramping system. When on, enabled knobs will automatically sweep through their range.

spread.title: Spread
spread.description: Lets you apply stereo spread to only one channel. This might be helpful, for example, if you want a wide stereo reverb with an echo cutting through the middle.

miso.label: MISO
miso.description: Mono In Stereo Out: Sums the input to mono before processing, then outputs in stereo. Useful for mono sources.

spreadDip.label: Spread DIP
spreadDip.description: Enables the Spread control. When off, stereo image is controlled only by the blend knob.

midiClockFollow.label: MIDI Clock Follow
midiClockFollow.description: When enabled, time-based effects sync to incoming MIDI clock. Tap tempo is ignored when active.

unsync.label: Unsync
unsync.description: When enabled, left and right time parameters are independent. When off, both channels share the same time setting.

lSubdivision.label: L Tap Subdivision
lSubdivision.description: When synced to MIDI clock or tap tempo, sets the time subdivision for the left channel.

rSubdivision.label: R Tap Subdivision
rSubdivision.description: When synced to MIDI clock or tap tempo, sets the time subdivision for the right channel.

resonator.title: Resonator
resonator.description: Selects the resonator algorithm (requires the latest pedal firmware). Sent as MIDI CC33.

options.Hybrid: New hybrid blend of the original and distorted resonators (CC33: 0-1)

firmwareToggle.label: New Firmware
firmwareToggle.description: Enable if your pedal runs the latest firmware, which adds 3 selectable resonator modes. The Resonator selector (MIDI CC33) is only shown and sent when this is on. Update your pedal at firmware.chasebliss.com.

latch.label: Latch
latch.description: Changes footswitch behavior: when on, tap to toggle effect on/off. When off, effect is only active while holding the switch.

trails.label: Trails
trails.description: When on, effects trail off naturally when bypassed. When off, effects cut immediately on bypass.

bank.label: Bank
bank.description: Enables preset bank mode for accessing additional presets via MIDI program changes.

polarity.label: Polarity
polarity.description: Inverts the expression pedal polarity. Use if your expression pedal works backwards.
